tldr: A new send-invite endpoint lets admins invite staged users. The invite moves them to Invited, keeps their provisioned role and access, and sends an email.
goal: Admins need to invite staged users with the same configuration as net-new users.

story.heading: Admin Console adds the staged user invite command
story.body: The command moves staged users to Invited and sends their invitation emails.

story.heading: Entity Framework adds the member lookup by email
story.body: The repository reads members by organization ID and a list of emails.

story.heading: Dapper calls the new member lookup procedure
story.body: The repository calls OrganizationUser_ReadManyByOrganizationIdEmails to find staged users by email.

story.heading: API adds a send-invite endpoint for staged users
story.body: POST send-invite passes the selected staged users to the invite command.

story.heading: SQL Server adds the member lookup procedure
story.body: A new stored procedure reads organization users by organization ID and emails.

story.heading: Admins invite staged users with their provisioned access
story.body: Admins invite staged users, and each keeps the role, collections and groups it was given.

components.summary: Adds POST send-invite, which passes selected staged users to the invite command.
Adds the command that invites staged users and extends OrganizationService.
Adds a repository method that reads organization users by organization ID and emails.
Adds a repository method that reads organization users by organization ID and emails.
Adds the OrganizationUser_ReadManyByOrganizationIdEmails stored procedure and migration script.

decisions.title: Skip failed members and report each one
decisions.why: Missing or non-staged members do not fail the batch. Each requested member gets its own result.

decisions.title: Reserve seats once for the whole set
decisions.why: Seat expansion succeeds for every eligible member or fails for all of them.

decisions.title: Add a dedicated send-invite endpoint
decisions.why: The staged user row action needs its own API entrypoint.

decisions.title: Grant Secrets Manager access by standalone discount
decisions.why: An organization with the Secrets Manager standalone discount grants access to everyone.
